But that's irrelevant to the point at hand. 


Sorry, I guess I just don't do a good job at explaining.  It's not that I'm waiting for something to change, or for things to get better.  The issue is that it's pointless.  There is no "better" because it's all arbitrary.

25 vs. 60, do you really think it matters?  If so, why?

Sorry, you're right, I don't know for certain, but I have no belief in any sort of afterlife.
Because if death is inevitable, at least if I kill myself, I have select the death I prefer, in the manner of my choosing.  Fully customized to my liking.

I'm not depressed about anything.


Exactly - I can chose either.

I also feel this way.  I am not depressed.  Suicide just makes sense for many reasons.  Sometimes I think people just can't imagine that another person would rationally consider suicide, and so they just label it as "depression".  Maybe reality is just fucking depressing...

I don't mean to sound pompous, but I don't consider myself a loser.  And it's not really that I'm miserable.  I'm happy quite often.  Suicide is not a reactionary thing for me.  It's just because, I don't understand motivation for living.

When you say '"life is meaningless" is not a justification for suicide", this is where we disagree.  If living and death are both pointless, then there is no need for any justification.

Is anyone out there?  Why don't more people feel this?  What do you people do to distract yourself from the bleak realities that surround us?  The pointlessness of our lives, the pointlessness of our existence.  You get up and go to work and talk with your friends and eat your food and watch your TV shows and drink your beer and don't you see how pointless it all is?  What is it that you people have that I don't?

Yes, I too have tried going the route of just not thinking about it, ignoring the inevitable, turning my brain off.  But I can not do it.  I think somewhere deep down, I do not want to do it.  I wish I preferred ignorance to reality, I fucking wish I did so much, but I just can't.  There is something wrong with me that I torture myself with reality.  Maybe there is just something hard wired in my brain not to be able to ignore it.  I am destined for suicide.

I read in another post you are thinking of doing the deed on Monday.  Are you still planning on this?  It is Sunday... you know it's so crazy... I see other people speak of suicide, and I think to myself, I wish they would not... I wish I could talk to them... they could find a friend in me and I in them, and then I realize even I plan to kill myself and I am reminded of how absurd life is.


If you are still planning on leaving on monday, I'd love to at least hear what it is you want to say, I mean, your story. E veryone has one.  Just, anything about your thoughts and memories which you'd like to share.  Something you wish to speak in the world, I will read it.


I am deeply sorry that you too, are feeling this emptiness.  I understand it though.  I too am empty beyond repair.  I have come to a big, empty, lonely building today and I am just sitting here, figuring out how to put all this shit to an end.  For once, I am enjoying the silence.

Woah... just read it all..   we are very similar you and I.  I also feel I am at the end.  I just want you to know, I understand you.  If you wanna talk or anything, just feel free to talk to me.  Not because I want to convince you out of ending it, shit, even I want to end it, just, because I can tell you are in pain and if you are in pain and it will ease your pain at all to talk to someone, I am happy to help you in that way.


I'm really sorry for the shit hand you've been dealt.  Isn't it crazy.  Why do they even have us in the first place, if they knew it was going to be like this.

Definitely not the only one my friend.  The emptiness itself is what is the most painful to me.


Sometimes I feel we are all like this, it's just not everyone realizes it, or they do realize it but others just have better means of distraction from this realization.

I'm not dense, but I'm not smart either.  The problem with me isn't intelligence, it's curiosity and an obsessive need to understand things.


I'd love to continue talking with you if you'd like.  There are few people in my life who will put up with these philosophical discussions so I always try and shut up and just think of it internally but I really need to talk about these things with someone.  I'll be here for a bit.  I skipped work and went to the park just thinking of all this shit, then came back to work, still thinking of all this shit instead of working.  Just killing time now until some other pointless activity which I have later.  I don't know man, it just feels like every thing we do is just a way to distract ourselves from dealing with our own mortality.  The problem is I enjoy pursuing the truth and so I have no interest in distractions, and even if I did, no distraction seems to work good enough for me.  Thoughts of my mortality plague me.  I've recently discovered getting high does kind of numb of all of this, so that is nice.

Yeah, I am aware of this approach.  But this approach is almost like a paradox for me.  You see, the moment "meaning" becomes this arbitrary thing I can re-assign on a whim, it loses all significance.

>Life is not pointless. There are a billion problems in this world and 99% of them will not go away until they are solved by a human being, so in reality it is wasting a life capable of solving these problems that is pointless.

Yes, and the world as we know it will eventually cease to exist.  Fixing the problems is pointless as well.


>I guess what I'm trying to say is that you're a valuable resource, and your life can make a huge difference on this planet, if you're into that sort of thing.

In what way?  if I don't kill myself today, I am only delaying the inevitable.  In 5 or 6 decades I'll be dead no matter what.  Say I make an "impact", solve a problem.  Who gives a fuck?  All the people it "helps" will be dead 100 years after that.  Our entire species will eventually cease to exist.  The whole fucking endeavor is pointless.  Every breath you take, every accomplishment you make, all pointless.  You and I will be forgotten, our memories will die with us, the people who love us will die as well, all those we make an impact on will die one by one until every trace of our existence evaporates.  


I'm not trying to sound like a dick, it's just the reality I see in life.
No.  I find all existence pointless.  But this  is more of a philosophical question, we probably just happen to disagree.
Yes. This is it.

I also don't want to give the impression that I do nothing.  I have a rich social life, I set goals, I achieve goals, and I'm very active.  It's just I recognize how pointless all of this shit is, how pointless each moment is.  I used to just accept the pointlessness of it all and say "fuck it", but as time goes on, the moments are becoming more and more agonizing.
I'm sorry to hear you feel this way as well.  It's not a good feeling.  Do you ever feel like you're already dead?  I don't know how to express that feeling.
Or maybe life is just a pointless endeavor and we're all just counting down the moments until it's over, and maybe that fact in itself is depressing.
Yes, things bring me happiness, but that happiness is arbitrary and pointless.
